name: Insured Benefit
sourceRefs: Stedi (stedi.com/edi/x12-005010/segment/INS) — X12 005010 INS segment element reference. New for Phase 3 (270/271), used at 2100C/2100D to carry INS01 (Y=subscriber is the insured / N=this is a dependent) and INS02 (Individual Relationship Code — same code set PAT02/SBR02 already use elsewhere in this schema library, e.g. '18'=Self, '01'=Spouse, '19'=Child). INS03-05 (maintenance type/reason, benefit status) modeled as flat elements since they're situational, single-occurrence, no composite complexity — INS06 (Medicare Status composite) and INS10 (Handicapped Indicator) deliberately not modeled (core-fields-only, matching this project's own established 'core fields, not exhaustive' precedent from 835/837).
